description: Java class implementing a SASL authenticator for the Eclipse Hono project, supporting PLAIN and EXTERNAL mechanisms, handling client certificate extraction, and delegating credential verification to an AuthenticationService.

classes.name: HonoSaslAuthenticator
classes.description: A SASL authenticator supporting PLAIN and EXTERNAL mechanisms, extracting client certificates, and delegating authentication.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the authenticator with socket, connection, and transport, setting up SASL mechanisms and extracting client certificates if TLS is used.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles the SASL authentication process, selecting mechanisms, and processing responses.

methods.name: getSaslOutcomeForErrorStatus
methods.description: Maps HTTP error codes to SASL outcomes.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Creates an authentication request and delegates to the AuthenticationService, including client certificate DN if available.
